basic_info.description: Nestled in the heart of San Francisco's desirable Central Richmond district, this delightful residence offers a blend of classic charm and modern convenience. The property is just a short stroll from the Golden Gate Park, providing easy access to outdoor activities, cultural attractions, and serene landscapes.​ The neighborhood boasts various dining and shopping options along Geary Boulevard and Clement Street, which are known for their eclectic eateries, boutiques, and markets. Excellent public transportation options are available, ensuring effortless commutes throughout the city. This residence offers a warm and inviting atmosphere with its original hardwood floors, high ceilings, and abundant natural light. The spacious living room features a cozy fireplace, perfect for relaxing evenings. The formal dining room boasts elegant period details, making it ideal for entertaining guests. The private backyard offers a serene retreat with a landscaped garden and patio area suitable for outdoor dining and relaxation. A one-car garage provides convenient parking and additional storage space. Don't miss this opportunityschedule a viewing today!
